title: The Door in the Wall
author: H.G. Wells
short_description: A successful politician is haunted all his life by a green door that led once to a paradise — and which he never entered again.
description: As a child, Lionel Wallace opened a white door in a wall and found a garden of indescribable beauty and peace. Three times in his adult life the door appeared — and each time ambition kept him walking past. The fourth time he opened it and was found dead in a construction pit.
